scripts.build: wp-scripts build && npm run pdfjs && npm run rtl
scripts.rtl: rtlcss assets/admin/css/admin.css assets/admin/css/admin-rtl.css && rtlcss assets/css/frontend.css assets/css/frontend-rtl.css
scripts.pdfjs: rm -rf assets/vendor/pdfjs && mkdir -p assets/vendor/pdfjs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs assets/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.js && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs assets/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.js && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts assets/vendor/pdfjs/ && rsync -a --exclude='*quickjs*' node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm/ assets/vendor/pdfjs/wasm/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/LICENSE assets/vendor/pdfjs/LICENSE
